steps.description:
Just like the way your check the Button and Ultrasonic sensors, you can form conditions to check a variable value using the comparison operators.



The code below displays a variable with increasing value.


By adding the following blocks (you may need to duplicate some), display "in range" when the variable value is from 5 to 10 and "out of range" if otherwise.

A Random Integer block generates a random whole number between two values. Below shows how you can set a variable to a random value from 5 to 10.


You are creating a Virtual Lucky Spin shown below. 

    

Using the blocks below, make you code perform as follows:

1. Generate a random number 1 to 10.

2. Display the random number on the top row and the result at the bottom. There are two possible results:

  • "Mystery Gift" when the number is 3 or 7.


  • "Try Again" when it is others.
